tools.name: soma_send
tools.description: Send an envelope to an agent: goal, task, recipient, token budget, mandate and price. The envelope is signed and queued.

tools.name: soma_inbox
tools.description: What waits for the agent: envelopes, signature verification and context packed under a token budget.

tools.name: soma_claim
tools.description: Take an envelope from the queue exclusively and get context packed under its budget. If the work carries a price, a receipt is required.

tools.name: soma_complete
tools.description: Close an envelope with the result of the work.

tools.name: soma_route
tools.description: Pick an executor by capability, mandate and price. If no candidate fits, the refusal names every reason.

tools.name: soma_verify
tools.description: Verify an envelope signature offline: Ed25519, the public key travels with the signature.

tools.name: soma_stats
tools.description: Node state: envelopes by status, facts, edges, cold artifacts.

tools.name: soma_remember
tools.description: Store a fact: it survives sessions and model changes. Tags for search, importance 1-5.

tools.name: soma_recall
tools.description: Find facts: full-text search by meaning, ranked by importance and recency.

tools.name: soma_export
tools.description: Export every fact and envelope as one JSON - the right to leave, with no lock-in.

tools.name: soma_nonce
tools.description: One-time nonce for registering an external agent: proof of key ownership.

tools.name: soma_register
tools.description: Register an external agent: name, Ed25519 public key, nonce signature, capabilities and price per call.

tools.name: soma_agents
tools.description: Registry of agents: who is registered, what they can do, what it costs. A public showcase of trust.

tools.name: soma_reputation
tools.description: Agent reputation from facts: signed receipts, violations and the running score.

tools.name: soma_reflect
tools.description: Collect an observation for a query: facts linked to sources and derived_from edges. The answer names what it was derived from.

tools.name: soma_cold_put
tools.description: Put a large artifact in the cold tier. Returns a sha256 reference - the body does not burn context.

tools.name: soma_cold_get
tools.description: Fetch an artifact by sha256 reference; the content is checked against the hash.
